title: canonical-failure-signature-catalog-and-sli-exposure-matrix
creator: Lina Park
description: Build a canonical, searchable catalog of runtime failure signatures and an SLI exposure matrix that maps failure classes (client timeouts, server timeouts, overload/backpressure, model runtime errors, partial responses, HTTP/gRPC codes) to alerts, SLO impact, and recommended mitigations. This ticket covers schema design, trace/log enrichment, a metricized pipeline for extraction, and a Grafana dashboard that lets on-call and SREs pivot from a high-level SLO-exposure view into trace anchors and exemplar logs.
acceptance_criteria: A single JSON-LD-compatible failure signature schema exists and is checked into docs (Confluence + repo) with fields: signature_id, symptom, surface, example_trace_span, canonical_error_code, likely_root_causes, mitigation_steps, severity
Tracing hooks emit failure.signature_id and failure.stage for any terminal and intermediate error types across API, router, runtime, and model-worker layers
Log/metrics pipeline enriches and indexes failure.signature_id and model_variant so dashboards can slice by model, region, and deployment mode
Grafana 'SLI Exposure Matrix' panel shows top 10 signatures by 7d token-loss and request-count and links to trace anchors; clicking a signature opens a trace sample and a playbook snippet
On-call runbook contains mapped alert thresholds and automated fallback recommendations for the top 5 high-severity signatures
tasks: Design failure signature schema and publish to /confluence/obs/failure-signatures
Add tracing hook points: ingress (API proxy), router, runtime scheduler, model-worker, postprocess
Implement trace span attribute + log field: failure.signature_id, failure.stage, failure.symptom, model.variant
Update log ingestion pipeline to derive signature_id from span/log correlation and index in ClickHouse/ES
Create Grafana dashboard panels and drilldowns; build URL template to open trace viewer with trace_id
Author runbook entries for top-5 signatures and add to ops/playbooks repo
Add unit/integration tests for signature detection logic and CI gate
